## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is filed under the correct paper.
- [ ] New factual claims are traceable to a primary source.
- [ ] Notation is defined before use and remains consistent.
- [ ] Relative Markdown links resolve correctly.
- [ ] Inline and display math render correctly on GitHub.
- [ ] The pull request is focused enough for line-by-line review.
